findings.message: The field "First name" asks for the user's first name but does not identify that purpose: autocomplete="given-name" is missing. Chromium's own form check flags this field too.

patch.before: <input type="text" name="first_name" placeholder="First name" required="" id="id_first_name">
patch.after: <input type="text" name="first_name" placeholder="First name" required="" id="id_first_name" autocomplete="given-name">

findings.message: The field "Email" asks for the user's email address but does not identify that purpose: autocomplete="email" is missing. Chromium's own form check flags this field too.
